dateline: BTS closed night one of the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas (Sept 18) with a four-song 'ARIRANG' set — 'SWIM,' '2.0,' 'MIC Drop' and 'FYA' — their first appearance at the festival in six years. The brief ~16-minute slot drew ARMY criticism over its length compared to other acts and over sound, camera and lighting issues, with neither iHeartRadio nor HYBE responding publicly. The ARIRANG World Tour's Latin American leg opens in Bogotá on Oct 2-3, followed by Lima, Santiago, La Plata and São Paulo through October.
heroHeadline: Day 4,847: BTS Closes iHeartRadio Festival Night 1, Fans Push Back on Short Set
heroSubtitle: September 20, 2026 is Day 4,847 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. All seven members — RM, Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin, V and Jungkook — closed out night one of the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas on Sept 18, performing 'SWIM,' '2.0,' 'MIC Drop' and 'FYA' from 'ARIRANG' under a 'BTS 2.0' visual theme — their first appearance at the festival in six years. The roughly 16-minute set, streamed on Disney+ and Hulu alongside Cardi B, Snoop Dogg and Benson Boone, drew ARMY criticism afterward over its brevity next to other acts' longer slots and over sound, camera and lighting issues; neither iHeartRadio nor HYBE has addressed the complaints. The tour's Latin American leg opens in Bogotá, Colombia on Oct 2-3 before continuing to Lima, Santiago, La Plata and São Paulo.
